title: Net effective rent (NER) calculator
description: Net effective rent calculator: straight-line and discounted NER per SF after free rent, TI allowance and leasing commissions, with every step shown.
example_case: 10-year deal, 6 months free, TI and LC, 8% discount

title: Debt sizing calculator: DSCR, LTV, debt yield
h1: Debt sizing calculator (DSCR, LTV and debt yield)
description: Debt sizing calculator: maximum commercial loan under DSCR, LTV and debt yield tests, the binding constraint, stress scenarios and refinance shortfall.

title: CAM reconciliation calculator
description: CAM reconciliation calculator: tenant share of operating expenses with gross-up, controllable caps, admin fees, base year or expense stop, and balance due.

title: Yield maintenance and defeasance calculator
description: Yield maintenance and defeasance calculator: prepayment premium and total payoff for a fixed-rate loan, plus step-down and flat-percentage penalties.
example_case: yield maintenance on an interest-only loan, PV of payments at Treasury flat

title: ASC 842 lease remeasurement calculator
description: ASC 842 lease remeasurement calculator: new lease liability, ROU asset adjustment, gain, and the operating or finance lease schedule after a modification.
example_case: operating lease, term extended, monthly payments in arrears, rate updated

title: WALT calculator: weighted average lease term
description: WALT calculator: weighted average lease term remaining in years, weighted by leased area or annual rent, from any as-of date, with expired leases flagged.

title: Direct capitalization (cap rate) calculator
description: Direct capitalization calculator: property value from NOI and a cap rate, or the cap rate a price implies, with reserves and lease-up deductions.
example_case: value with reserves and below-the-line adjustments, and the cap rate the price implies (hand check: 975,000 ÷ 6.5% = 15,000,000)

title: Equity waterfall calculator (LP/GP promote)
h1: Equity waterfall calculator (LP/GP pref, catch-up and promote)
description: Equity waterfall calculator: LP/GP distributions with preferred return, catch-up, IRR hurdle tiers and promote, plus each party's IRR and multiple.
example_case: annual: compounding 8% pref, full catch-up to 20%, 80/20 to a 12% LP IRR, 70/30 to 15%, 60/40 after
